_comment: Captions for an Instafill vertical Short built from phone screenshots (1080x1920): the phone's screen fills the frame, so the card is an opaque navy slab over the lower part of it, above the title and buttons YouTube draws on a Short. White words, the email's #78A7FF on the word being spoken.

overlays._note: Colour of the SOURCE video's own lower-third graphics to dodge, not the colour of this card. A screencast has none, so there is nothing to dodge.

_geometry.target: projects/agent-batch-filling-short: the screen fills y 150..1920; film.js keeps what the voice names above y 1400
_geometry.why_bottom_margin_330: a two-line card spans about y 1400..1590: under the action, above the Shorts title and description (from about y 1630), and at most 780 wide so it stays clear of the like/comment column on the right
